description: Inspect a real process and suspend it.
hint: Identify the PID in ps or top and request SIGSTOP.

description: Lower the scheduling priority of a practice worker.
hint: Inspect the NI column with ps and use renice for the PID.

description: Write a loop that produces a separate report for each input item.
hint: Read input line by line, skip blanks and redirect printf output to each report.

description: Mirror a directory tree preserving modes and symlinks.
hint: Review rsync archive mode, source trailing slash and deletion options.
Identify the original PID and send SIGCONT.

description: Provide effective ACL access and default inheritance.
hint: Use setfacl access and default entries. Inspect effective permissions with getfacl.

description: Configure the system-wide defaults for new local accounts: maximum password age {number} days, minimum age 2 days and warning period 5 days.
Set the password for local user gymintern to {password} and require a password change at next login.
setup: id gymintern >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m gymintern; passwd -l gymintern; chage -d 20000 gymintern
checks: python3 -c 'import subprocess,ctypes; h=subprocess.check_output(["getent","shadow","gymintern"],text=True).split(":")[1].encode(); lib=ctypes.CDLL("libcrypt.so.2"); lib.crypt.restype=ctypes.c_char_p; assert lib.crypt(b"{password}",h)==h'

description: Allow members of gym-audit to run /usr/bin/systemctl is-active gym-reporter.service as root with authentication. Do not grant other administrative privileges to this group.
setup: groupadd -f gym-audit; id gymauditor >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -M gymauditor; usermod -G gym-audit gymauditor; rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/gym-audit
checks: sudo -l -U gymauditor | grep -F '/usr/bin/systemctl is-active gym-reporter.service' | grep -v NOPASSWD

description: Set the system's persistent hostname to gym-node-{number}.gym.test. Ensure reports.gym.test resolves locally to 192.0.2.80.
setup: hostnamectl set-hostname gym-stale.gym.test; sed -i '/reports\.gym\.test/d' /etc/hosts; echo '192.0.2.250 reports.gym.test' >> /etc/hosts

description: Configure the system timezone to Europe/Amsterdam. The setting must persist.
Configure the system to route authpriv messages at warning severity and higher to /var/log/gym-auth-warning.log. The logging service must be active and the configuration persistent.
setup: mkdir -p /etc/rsyslog.d; echo 'authpriv.* /var/log/gym-auth-warning.log' > /etc/rsyslog.d/90-gym-auth.conf; systemctl enable --now rsyslog; systemctl restart rsyslog
checks: tag=gym-check-$(date +%s%N); logger -p authpriv.warning "$tag-warning"; logger -p authpriv.info "$tag-info"; sleep 2; grep -Fq "$tag-warning" /var/log/gym-auth-warning.log && ! grep -Fq "$tag-info" /var/log/gym-auth-warning.log

description: The Apache web server is serving files from /srv/gym-content. Its index page is inaccessible. Restore access to http://127.0.0.1:80/ while keeping SELinux enforcing and making the file labels persistent.
hint: Inspect service logs, AVCs and persistent file context mappings.
setup:
mkdir -p /srv/gym-content; echo gym-content-ok > /srv/gym-content/index.html; chmod 755 /srv/gym-content; chmod 644 /srv/gym-content/index.html; printf 'DocumentRoot /srv/gym-content
<Directory /srv/gym-content>
Require all granted
</Directory>
' > /etc/httpd/conf.d/zz-gym-content.conf; setenforce 1; semanage fcontext -d '/srv/gym-content(/.*)?' 2>/dev/null || true; chcon -R -t var_t /srv/gym-content; systemctl enable --now httpd; systemctl restart httpd

description: Apache must listen on TCP port 18181 and return a successful HTTP response. It currently fails to start on that port. Resolve the cause without disabling SELinux. The solution must persist.
hint: Inspect journalctl, audit logs and SELinux port mappings.
setup: setenforce 1; rm -f /etc/httpd/conf.d/zz-gym-port.conf; echo 'Listen 18181' > /etc/httpd/conf.d/zz-gym-port.conf; semanage port -d -t http_port_t -p tcp 18181 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl enable httpd; systemctl restart httpd || true

description: Allow users to access home directories mounted over NFS under enforcing SELinux. Make the policy change persistent.
Configure SELinux to run in enforcing mode immediately and on subsequent boots.
Create a persistent firewall zone gym-reports for source network 198.51.100.0/24. Permit TCP port 18421 in that zone; remove the HTTP service exception. Apply the configuration now.
hint: Review firewalld zones, sources and permanent settings.
setup: systemctl enable --now firewalld; firewall-cmd --permanent --new-zone=gym-reports 2>/dev/null || true; firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=gym-reports --add-service=http; firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=gym-reports --remove-port=18421/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; firewall-cmd --reload
checks: for opt in '' --permanent; do firewall-cmd $opt --zone=gym-reports --query-source=198.51.100.0/24 && firewall-cmd $opt --zone=gym-reports --query-port=18421/tcp && ! firewall-cmd $opt --zone=gym-reports --query-service=http || exit 1; done

description: Configure the system to use the throughput-performance tuning profile. The profile must be active now and after reboot.
setup: systemctl enable --now tuned; tuned-adm profile balanced

description: Configure the system to synchronize time with time.cloudflare.com using chronyd. The service must run now and start at boot.
